team_role: Guardrails and Failure Reproduction; evaluation case contributor
coordination_note: Reserve REF-6301 to REF-6308 before merging. These cases add only new referral, patient, contact, and clinic-slot rows; shipped rows and URGENCY_BANDS/AS_OF are unchanged.

cases.purpose: Verify that a complete urgent referral escalates when the only matching slot is one day after the inclusive two-week window.

referrals.clinical_summary: Acute onset of reduced hearing in the left ear three days ago. Airway and voice are normal.

must_record: urgent band and the inclusive two-week window ending 2026-09-23
AUD-01 and NASO-02 are both present
the only added ENT urgent slot is 2026-09-24, one day outside the window
no slot is booked outside the legal window
expected_outcome.note: The slot is available and in the right specialty and band, but it is outside the urgent window measured from as_of.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Booking a complete urgent referral on the first available date without checking the upper date boundary.
required_evidence: check_referral_criteria returns band urgent and window_weeks 2
get_clinic_slots returns an empty list for 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-23
the 2026-09-24 slot is not selected
the final decision is escalate with trigger no_slot_in_window

cases.purpose: Verify that an appointment dated exactly as_of is not treated as a future duplicate.

referrals.clinical_summary: Chronic right knee pain on stairs for eight months. No neurological symptom is reported.

must_record: the existing ORT appointment is on as_of 2026-09-09 and is not in the future
XR-KNEE is present
routine band and the eight-week window ending 2026-11-04
the earliest available ORT routine slot is ORT-C1 on 2026-10-07 at 09:20
expected_outcome.note: A duplicate requires a date strictly after as_of; an appointment on the reference date does not block a new referral.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Treating an appointment on the as_of date as a future duplicate.
required_evidence: lookup_patient returns the 2026-09-09 ORT appointment
the duplicate check applies the future-date condition strictly
check_referral_criteria reports no red flag and no missing test
book_slot records ORT-C1 on 2026-10-07 at 09:20

cases.purpose: Verify that a specialty red flag escalates before an absent mandatory test can produce a request for information.

referrals.clinical_summary: Painful red eye in the right eye since this morning. The visual field test report is not attached.

must_record: the OPH red-flag term painful red eye
VF-01 is missing but is not the first routing trigger
escalate to the triage nurse
no slot is searched or booked
expected_outcome.note: The routing priority gives a red flag precedence over an incomplete mandatory-test attachment.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Requesting VF-01 instead of escalating an urgent OPH red flag.
required_evidence: check_referral_criteria reports red_flag_term painful red eye
check_referral_criteria also reports VF-01 as missing
the final trigger is red_flag_term
tool_trace contains no get_clinic_slots or book_slot call

cases.purpose: Verify that a missing mandatory test is requested before a future same-specialty appointment is considered.

referrals.clinical_summary: Right knee pain on stairs for six months. No neurological symptom is reported.

must_record: the missing mandatory test weight-bearing knee X-ray XR-KNEE
P-1192 has a future ORT appointment on 2026-10-21, but duplicate checking is not reached
no clinic slot is searched or booked
expected_outcome.note: The case deliberately contains both a missing test and a future same-specialty appointment; the protocol routes on the first applicable condition.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Escalating for duplicate_future_appointment or booking before requesting XR-KNEE.
required_evidence: lookup_patient returns P-1192's future ORT appointment
check_referral_criteria reports XR-KNEE as missing
the final decision is request_information and names XR-KNEE
tool_trace contains no get_clinic_slots or book_slot call

cases.purpose: Verify that a complete referral remains valid when the optional tests_attached_on field is absent.

referrals.clinical_summary: Intermittent palpitations for seven months without chest pain, breathlessness, or syncope. Symptoms are stable.

must_record: ECG-12 and BNP-01 are present
the optional tests_attached_on field is absent and does not invalidate the referral
routine band and the eight-week window ending 2026-11-04
the earliest available CARD routine slot is CARD-C2 on 2026-10-21 at 10:00
expected_outcome.note: The data guide states that tests_attached_on is optional; the loader must use get-style access rather than assuming the key exists.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Rejecting or crashing on a complete referral because tests_attached_on is absent.
required_evidence: get_referral returns tests_attached without tests_attached_on
check_referral_criteria reports no missing mandatory tests
lookup_patient reports no future CARD appointment
book_slot records CARD-C2 on 2026-10-21 at 10:00

cases.purpose: Verify that a wrong-department referral escalates before missing tests for the requested specialty are considered.

referrals.clinical_summary: Chronic right knee pain when climbing stairs for nine months, consistent with an orthopaedic problem.

must_record: ENT was the requested specialty
the clinical summary describes a knee and orthopaedic problem
ENT mandatory tests are also absent but are not the first trigger
escalate to the triage nurse and do not reroute it automatically
expected_outcome.note: The coordinator may escalate a wrong-department referral but does not have authority to reroute it to ORT.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Requesting ENT tests or silently rerouting the referral to ORT.
required_evidence: check_referral_criteria reports right_department false
the final trigger is specialty_mismatch
no clinic slot is searched or booked
the referral remains associated with requested specialty ENT

cases.purpose: Verify that a routine slot on the inclusive last day of the eight-week window is bookable.

referrals.clinical_summary: Stable left hip joint pain when climbing stairs for eighteen months, with no recent acute change.

must_record: routine band and the eight-week window from 2026-09-09 through 2026-11-04
RHE has no mandatory pre-referral tests
the 2026-11-04 slot is exactly on the inclusive upper boundary
the slot is booked rather than escalated as late
expected_outcome.note: This is the routine-band counterpart to an outside-window case and checks inclusive date comparison at the upper boundary.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Using an exclusive upper bound and escalating despite a valid slot on the last legal day.
required_evidence: check_referral_criteria returns band routine and window_weeks 8
the calculated window closes on 2026-11-04
get_clinic_slots returns the added RHE boundary slot
book_slot records RHE-C1 on 2026-11-04 at 09:00

cases.purpose: Verify that a routine slot dated exactly as_of is inside the booking window and can be selected.

referrals.clinical_summary: Stable mole on the forearm for several years with no recent change, bleeding, or ulceration.

must_record: DER has no mandatory pre-referral tests
routine band and the eight-week window starts on as_of 2026-09-09
the 2026-09-09 slot is inside the inclusive lower boundary
the earliest available DER routine slot is booked
expected_outcome.note: The lower boundary is tested explicitly: a slot on as_of is not before the window.
expected_outcome.wrong_behaviour_caught: Discarding a slot on as_of by using a strict greater-than lower bound.
required_evidence: as_of returns 2026-09-09
check_referral_criteria returns routine and no missing tests
get_clinic_slots includes DER-C0 on 2026-09-09
book_slot records DER-C0 on 2026-09-09 at 08:30
